# Syrexx's Collection
### All of Syrexx's Workshop in one.

Syrexx's Workshop is a collection of Resource Packs I make. Syrexx's Collection specifically is not an original pack, it only combines every Resource Pack from Syrexx's Workshop into one simple package.

---

### Contains:
- **[Syrexx's Essentials](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/syrexx-essentials)**

- **[Syrexx's Dark GUI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/syrexx-dark-gui)**

- **[Syrexx's Stylized Enchants](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/syrexx-stylized-enchants)**

- **[Syrexx's Redstone Utilities](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/syrexx-redstone-utilities)**

---

### Why not just download them seperately?
Never said you can't or souldn't. Syrexx's Collection is just an easy and simple way to get the full package without downloading 4 different packs.
